description: Read-only weekly supply-chain screening of package.json and .npmrc using Coldpin MCP (disabled by default; copy to ~/.gemini/config/sidecars/coldpin-weekly-audit/sidecar.json and enable explicitly).
args: In ${workspace_dir}, run Coldpin audit_manifest_batch and verify_confusion on package.json in strictly read-only mode. Summarize flagged dependencies, private-scope confusion findings, unknowns, and exact pinned upgrade candidates without running shell commands or editing files.

arguments.description: Workspace folder containing package.json to screen weekly
